cards.title: The player cannot move directly.
cards.description: Movement happens some other way: pushing, pulling, asking.

cards.title: The world changes every minute.
cards.description: Layouts, rules or weather reshuffle on a timer.

cards.title: Enemies help the player.
cards.description: The ones who attack are secretly on your side.

cards.title: Every action has a consequence.
cards.description: Even small choices ripple outward.

cards.title: The player controls the environment instead of a character.
cards.description: You move the world, not the hero.

cards.title: The game reverses its rules halfway through.
cards.description: What helped you now works against you.

cards.title: You play as the monster.
cards.description: The usual villain is the one you steer.

cards.title: The map is a person's memory.
cards.description: Places fade or change as memories do.

cards.title: You can only move when others aren't looking.
cards.description: Eyes are the real enemy.

cards.title: Your tools have limited uses.
cards.description: Every item you use is gone for good.

cards.title: Death is a resource.
cards.description: Dying is something you spend to get ahead.

cards.title: The player is the final boss.
cards.description: Everyone else works together against you.

cards.title: The level is alive.
cards.description: The map itself reacts and moves.

cards.title: Time only moves when you move.
cards.description: Stand still and the world freezes.

cards.title: You share your body with a stranger.
cards.description: Two minds, one set of controls.

cards.title: The UI is part of the world.
cards.description: Menus and meters can be touched, broken or used.

cards.title: Gravity belongs to objects, not the world.
cards.description: Each thing pulls in its own direction.

cards.title: Everything you collect also follows you.
cards.description: Pick things up and they trail behind you.

cards.title: There's no text, only symbols.
cards.description: Understanding is the puzzle.

cards.title: The game remembers across runs.
cards.description: Earlier attempts leave marks on later ones.

cards.title: The player can't see their own character.
cards.description: You steer by sound or by others' reactions.

cards.title: Walls are only suggestions.
cards.description: You can pass through, if you pay the price.

cards.title: Your companion makes the decisions.
cards.description: You guide, but they choose.

cards.title: Light is both weapon and weakness.
cards.description: What saves you also exposes you.

cards.title: You can only carry one thing.
cards.description: Every choice is a trade.

cards.title: Each level is a different genre.
cards.description: The rules keep changing shape.

cards.title: Cause and effect arrive out of order.
cards.description: Results appear before their causes.

cards.title: The world is tiny and you're huge.
cards.description: Move carefully: everything is fragile.

cards.title: You are always being followed.
cards.description: Something dogs your steps, closer each time.

cards.title: Silence is the strongest move.
cards.description: Making noise is the cost of acting.

cards.title: The enemy copies what you do.
cards.description: Everything you try comes right back at you.

cards.title: Anything can be a weapon.
cards.description: Objects have uses you wouldn't expect.

cards.title: Your inventory is a creature.
cards.description: It has moods, hungers and opinions.

cards.title: You can undo anything, but only once.
cards.description: One rewind per level, so choose well.

cards.title: The goal moves as you approach.
cards.description: The finish line keeps shifting.

cards.title: Friendship is the only currency.
cards.description: Everything is bought with trust.

cards.title: Day is a platformer, night is a puzzle.
cards.description: Two halves of one world, played differently.

cards.title: Rules are written on the walls.
cards.description: Read the room to learn what's allowed.

cards.title: You win by losing on purpose.
cards.description: Failure is a strategy.

cards.title: The player writes the level as they play.
cards.description: The path appears behind your pen.

cards.title: Each NPC remembers a different story.
cards.description: The truth is spread across everyone.

cards.title: You shrink every time you succeed.
cards.description: Winning makes your problems bigger.

cards.title: The weather is the enemy.
cards.description: Wind, rain and lightning hunt you.

cards.title: Controls flip each time you die.
cards.description: Left becomes right, and so on.

cards.title: Your shadow plays a different game.
cards.description: It has its own goals.

cards.title: Players take turns being the world.
cards.description: Half play, half make trouble.

cards.title: The map is a deck of cards.
cards.description: Draw and place to make the next room.

cards.title: You are invisible to everyone but one.
cards.description: Only a single character can see you.

cards.title: The final level is the first, again.
cards.description: You return, changed, to where you began.

cards.title: Every enemy is someone you've helped.
cards.description: The ones who come for you owe you.

cards.title: Making something takes away something else.
cards.description: Creation always has a cost.

cards.title: You only move to the beat.
cards.description: Every step, jump and swing must land on the rhythm of the music.

cards.title: The camera is a character with opinions.
cards.description: It wanders off, zooms in on what it likes and sulks when ignored.

cards.title: Every jump costs a coin.
cards.description: Movement and money share one pocket, so every leap is a purchase.

cards.title: You can rewind time, but enemies remember.
cards.description: Foes keep their memories of every rewound moment and adapt.

cards.title: The floor is a timeline.
cards.description: Walking left goes into the past and walking right into the future.

cards.title: Your health bar is the level's floor.
cards.description: Lose health and the ground under you shrinks.

cards.title: Every door leads somewhere random.
cards.description: No room connects the same way twice.

cards.title: You can only speak in questions.
cards.description: Every dialogue choice must be a question, and answers shape the world.

cards.title: The pause menu is a real place.
cards.description: Pausing drops you into a waiting room with its own secrets.

cards.title: Your reflection moves first.
cards.description: Mirrors show your next move a second before you make it.

cards.title: The game is played in one room.
cards.description: Everything happens in a single room that changes as the story goes on.

cards.title: Enemies only exist when you look at them.
cards.description: Turn away and threats vanish, turn back and they are closer.

cards.title: You lose a button each level.
cards.description: The control scheme gets smaller as you progress.

cards.title: Every item is alive and has feelings.
cards.description: Tools complain, cheer and refuse to work when mistreated.

cards.title: The hero is very old.
cards.description: Your character moves slowly but knows every shortcut.

cards.title: You play as the narrator.
cards.description: You describe the hero's actions and they try to follow your words.

cards.title: Sound is your only map.
cards.description: The screen is dark and echoes show where walls are.

cards.title: Your weapon is a musical instrument.
cards.description: Notes and chords replace attacks and spells.

cards.title: The world is folded paper.
cards.description: Fold and crease the level to connect distant places.

cards.title: Every enemy you defeat joins the level.
cards.description: Beaten foes become platforms, walls or furniture.

cards.title: The sun follows you.
cards.description: Wherever you go is daytime, and the dark creeps in behind you.

cards.title: You can swap places with any creature.
cards.description: Pick any living thing and trade bodies instantly.

cards.title: Everything is upside down at night.
cards.description: Gravity flips when the sun goes down.

cards.title: You carry your house on your back.
cards.description: Home is mobile, heavy and always with you.

cards.title: The level is drawn by a child.
cards.description: Wobbly crayon logic decides how everything behaves.

cards.title: Your footsteps stay forever.
cards.description: Every path you walk becomes a permanent trail others follow.

cards.title: The villain is your landlord.
cards.description: The evil force wants rent, and you owe it every week.

cards.title: Water remembers shapes.
cards.description: Puddles replay whatever passed through them.

cards.title: Every save costs a memory.
cards.description: Saving the game erases one thing your character knows.

cards.title: You can't stop moving.
cards.description: The hero walks forward forever, and you only steer.

cards.title: The world is a snow globe.
cards.description: Shake it to rearrange everything inside.

cards.title: Plants grow when you sing.
cards.description: Your voice is a gardening tool and a weapon.

cards.title: Your pet is the real hero.
cards.description: You are the sidekick to a brave little animal.

cards.title: You play backwards from the ending.
cards.description: The story starts at the credits and rewinds.

cards.title: Colors are physical.
cards.description: Red is hot, blue is slippery and green grows things.

cards.title: Every coin is a tiny person.
cards.description: Spending money means sending someone off on a job.

cards.title: The map is always wrong.
cards.description: Your only guide lies, but in a pattern you can learn.

cards.title: You are the last pixel.
cards.description: Everything else has faded, and you must repaint the world.

cards.title: Fear makes you bigger.
cards.description: The scarier things get, the larger and clumsier you become.

cards.title: You can only see in a small circle.
cards.description: A lantern radius is all the world you know.

cards.title: The game is played through a window.
cards.description: You watch a neighbor's life and nudge it from outside.

cards.title: Two players share one controller.
cards.description: One person moves and the other acts, at the same time.

cards.title: Every word you read becomes an object.
cards.description: Text in the world can be picked up and used.

cards.title: The enemy is boredom.
cards.description: Do nothing interesting for too long and the world fades.

cards.title: The level loops like a donut.
cards.description: Walk off one edge and arrive at the other.

cards.title: Your sword is shrinking.
cards.description: Every hit wears the blade down, so choose fights carefully.

cards.title: Monsters are scared of you.
cards.description: Creatures flee, and the challenge is catching them gently.

cards.title: You can stack anything.
cards.description: Every object in the world can be stacked into towers.

cards.title: Each life is a different character.
cards.description: When you die, someone new picks up where you left off.

cards.title: You can only act during thunder.
cards.description: Lightning flashes are the only moments you can move.

cards.title: The ground is a giant creature.
cards.description: The land breathes, itches and rolls over in its sleep.

cards.title: Every NPC is a past version of you.
cards.description: The townsfolk are echoes of your earlier playthroughs.

cards.title: Your shadow is a separate player.
cards.description: A friend controls the shadow that clings to your feet.

cards.title: The world is a single long scroll.
cards.description: There is only one direction and one very long journey.

cards.title: Time passes only when you speak.
cards.description: Silence freezes the world, and words make the clock tick.

cards.title: You are a ghost who can't touch anything.
cards.description: You can only act by scaring living things into moving.

cards.title: The screen is cracked.
cards.description: Broken glass splits the view into pieces that move separately.

cards.title: Every building is a puzzle box.
cards.description: Houses twist and slide open when solved.

cards.title: You eat the level to progress.
cards.description: Chew through walls, floors and furniture to find a way.

cards.title: Your health is your score.
cards.description: Taking damage directly lowers the points you keep.

cards.title: Heroes retire after every level.
cards.description: You recruit a fresh team each stage from those who stayed.

cards.title: Your past mistakes become enemies.
cards.description: Every failed attempt spawns a ghost that hunts you.

cards.title: Everything is made of cake.
cards.description: The world is edible and slowly melting.

cards.title: The game asks you for advice.
cards.description: Characters stop to ask what you would do, and they listen.

cards.title: You can only push, never pull.
cards.description: Every puzzle has to be solved by shoving.

cards.title: The map rotates when you blink.
cards.description: Each blink turns the world ninety degrees.

cards.title: Distance is measured in songs.
cards.description: Journeys are as long as the tracks you play on the way.

cards.title: The princess is the knight.
cards.description: Roles are swapped and nobody minds.

cards.title: Enemies are on strike.
cards.description: Foes refuse to fight until their demands are met.

cards.title: Your inventory spills when you run.
cards.description: Moving fast drops items behind you.

cards.title: Every room is a different time of day.
cards.description: Step through a door and morning becomes midnight.

cards.title: You are a tiny robot in a big kitchen.
cards.description: Ordinary household items become mountains and hazards.

cards.title: You must keep someone asleep.
cards.description: Every noise risks waking a sleeper you must not disturb.

cards.title: The level is a recipe.
cards.description: Ingredients are scattered and the order you collect them matters.

cards.title: Every attack heals the target a little.
cards.description: Fights are delicate balancing acts, not slugfests.

cards.title: You speak a language nobody knows.
cards.description: Communication happens through gestures and objects.

cards.title: Gravity points toward the nearest friend.
cards.description: Allies are the ground you stand on.

cards.title: The world is underwater and rising.
cards.description: Every hour the water climbs higher.

cards.title: Your shoes choose where you walk.
cards.description: Feet have a will of their own and must be bargained with.

cards.title: Everyone knows the ending but you.
cards.description: NPCs drop hints, wink and refuse to spoil it.

cards.title: The weather is controlled by your mood.
cards.description: Sad means rain, angry means storms, calm means clear skies.

cards.title: You can only use what you find today.
cards.description: Everything resets at dawn, items included.

cards.title: Light makes things solid.
cards.description: Shine a beam on fog and it becomes a bridge.

cards.title: The town shrinks every night.
cards.description: One building disappears each evening, and you choose which.

cards.title: Your companion is a cursed item.
cards.description: The talking object you carry has its own sinister goals.

cards.title: You see the level from above, others from inside.
cards.description: One player has the map and the other has the legs.

cards.title: Doors are alive and hungry.
cards.description: Feed a door the right thing to make it open.

cards.title: You leave when the music stops.
cards.description: Every stage ends when its song does, finished or not.

cards.title: Every chest contains a mimic, except one.
cards.description: Loot is a gamble, and reading tells keeps you alive.

cards.title: You play the clock.
cards.description: You are time itself, nudging events forward or back.

cards.title: Animals can read your mind.
cards.description: Every creature reacts to what you are planning, not doing.

cards.title: The game is a board game inside a game.
cards.description: Your moves are dice rolls on a living board.

cards.title: Your blood is ink.
cards.description: Getting hurt leaves marks you can draw with.

cards.title: Footsteps make bridges.
cards.description: Walking on air works, as long as you never stop.

cards.title: Your character is very forgetful.
cards.description: Skills vanish unless you practice them often.

cards.title: The city is built on a giant's palm.
cards.description: When the hand closes, the city must be ready.

cards.title: Every jump is permanent.
cards.description: Wherever you land becomes your new home base.

cards.title: You can trade years of your life.
cards.description: Age is a currency, spent for power and earned by resting.

cards.title: The enemies are your neighbors.
cards.description: Everyone on the street is a rival by day and a friend by night.

cards.title: You can only fight with words.
cards.description: Arguments, insults and compliments are your moves.

cards.title: Shadows are solid.
cards.description: Walk on shadows like platforms and dodge the light.

cards.title: Everything dies slowly, including you.
cards.description: A gentle decay timer touches every living thing in the game.

cards.title: Each level has a different gravity.
cards.description: Moon jumps, heavy feet and floating rooms rotate.

cards.title: The player is a building.
cards.description: You grow, add rooms and shelter those inside.

cards.title: There is no game over, only detours.
cards.description: Failure sends you down a different, stranger path.

cards.title: Every key opens the wrong door.
cards.description: Learn which key matches which lock by its quirks.

cards.title: The world reacts to your voice volume.
cards.description: Shout to break things, whisper to sneak.

cards.title: You are a stagehand, not the star.
cards.description: Move scenery and props so the actors' show goes well.

cards.title: The bosses are friendly.
cards.description: Big battles are dances, debates or cooking contests.

cards.title: You see what enemies see.
cards.description: The screen shows the guard's view, not yours.

cards.title: Your score is printed on a receipt.
cards.description: Every action adds a line, and the total decides the ending.

cards.title: You must hold your breath to act.
cards.description: Doing things uses air, and breathing makes you vulnerable.

cards.title: The game shrinks its window over time.
cards.description: The playable screen gets smaller until you finish.

cards.title: Cats rule the world.
cards.description: You live in a feline society with feline priorities.

cards.title: You can paste copies of yourself.
cards.description: Clone your character to hold buttons and block lasers.

cards.title: The world is a dream someone is waking from.
cards.description: Edges blur and fade as the dreamer stirs.

cards.title: Rain makes you stronger.
cards.description: Storms are power-ups and sunny days are hard.

cards.title: You see the future, not the present.
cards.description: The screen shows two seconds ahead, so you play by prediction.

cards.title: Every enemy is a tiny version of the boss.
cards.description: Learning small foes teaches you the final fight.

cards.title: Your hearts are actual hearts.
cards.description: Each health point is a beating creature you must keep happy.

cards.title: You are delivering the level.
cards.description: The stage is a package you carry and assemble on arrival.

cards.title: Furniture holds grudges.
cards.description: Bump into a chair and it will trip you later.

cards.title: The game is a radio broadcast.
cards.description: You hear the world through stations and tune into events.

cards.title: You can only move along lines you draw.
cards.description: Sketch a path first, then the hero follows it.

cards.title: Everything echoes for ten seconds.
cards.description: Your past actions repeat once, like an echo.

cards.title: The world is a museum after closing.
cards.description: Exhibits come alive and you play by night.

cards.title: Each step costs a word.
cards.description: You have a limited vocabulary to spend as fuel.

cards.title: You are both the cop and the thief.
cards.description: Swap roles each round and chase your own trail.

cards.title: Healing comes from helping strangers.
cards.description: Kindness is the only way to restore health.

cards.title: The village moves every morning.
cards.description: Wake up and the houses have wandered somewhere new.

cards.title: Your character is made of sand.
cards.description: Wind and water wear you down, and stillness rebuilds you.

cards.title: You must lose every fight to win the war.
cards.description: Defeats unlock secrets that victories hide.

cards.title: The map is tattooed on your back.
cards.description: You can only read it in mirrors.

cards.title: You can teleport only into darkness.
cards.description: Blink to any shadow, but never into light.

cards.title: Every level is a single screen.
cards.description: No scrolling, just one dense, layered puzzle scene.

cards.title: You can bribe the rules.
cards.description: Pay the game to suspend one rule at a time.

cards.title: The monster under the bed is your ally.
cards.description: The creature you feared helps you through the night.

cards.title: Your vision is a polaroid.
cards.description: You only see snapshots you take, not the live world.

cards.title: The world gets colder as you get richer.
cards.description: Wealth drains warmth from everything around you.

cards.title: You command a swarm, not a hero.
cards.description: Hundreds of tiny creatures act together under your lead.

cards.title: Everything you touch turns to gold.
cards.description: Useful at first, then a growing problem.

cards.title: Every NPC is lying.
cards.description: Truth hides between contradicting stories.

cards.title: You can only walk on what you have read.
cards.description: Books unfold into floors beneath your feet.

cards.title: Doors only open when you knock politely.
cards.description: Etiquette is the key to every lock.

cards.title: Seasons change with each level.
cards.description: Spring, summer, fall and winter rewrite the same map.

cards.title: You are a small fish getting bigger.
cards.description: Eat smaller things and avoid bigger ones as you grow.

cards.title: The level is a crossword puzzle.
cards.description: Fill in the right word to raise the right platform.

cards.title: Your feet are magnets.
cards.description: Stick to metal anywhere, but wood and stone fight back.

cards.title: The game wants you to quit.
cards.description: It nags, begs and tricks you into stopping.

cards.title: You must keep a candle lit.
cards.description: Wind, water and running all threaten your tiny flame.

cards.title: The world is drawn as you explore.
cards.description: Unvisited areas are blank paper until you arrive.

cards.title: Every hit swaps your weapon.
cards.description: Your attack changes each time you land a blow.

cards.title: You can bottle anything.
cards.description: Catch fire, wind, sound or light in jars for later.

cards.title: Gravity follows the music's pitch.
cards.description: High notes lift you and low notes drag you down.

cards.title: You can only save others, never yourself.
cards.description: Your own health never restores, but you can heal everyone else.

cards.title: The level grows a new room every visit.
cards.description: Return to a place and it has expanded.

cards.title: Strangers swap your items while you sleep.
cards.description: Every rest brings a mysterious new inventory.

cards.title: You are the tutorial.
cards.description: You teach a confused hero how the game works.

cards.title: Every bridge needs a password.
cards.description: Trolls and gates demand secret words found on the way.

cards.title: The world speaks in rhyme.
cards.description: Answers, spells and doors respond only to rhyming lines.

cards.title: The hero is allergic to the treasure.
cards.description: The thing you seek makes you sneeze and stumble.

cards.title: Time is a liquid you can pour.
cards.description: Fill a cup with time to speed up or slow down an area.

cards.title: You are trapped inside a vending machine.
cards.description: Navigate coils, coins and snacks to escape.

cards.title: The final boss is a mirror.
cards.description: You fight a copy of every choice you made.

cards.title: Your sidekick gets all the credit.
cards.description: Do the work while your partner earns the fame.

cards.title: Each level is a page of a diary.
cards.description: The writer's moods and doodles shape the stage.

cards.title: You can split in two.
cards.description: Divide into halves that move separately and rejoin later.

cards.title: Every death leaves a gravestone with advice.
cards.description: Your past selves leave notes for the next attempt.

cards.title: The world is a vinyl record.
cards.description: You run the groove, and scratching skips time.

cards.title: You build the dungeon, then raid it.
cards.description: Design a lair in one phase and invade it in the next.
